Plunder 1.7.1 — same features as 1.7.0, tidied up under the Plunder name.

**Download `Plunder.exe` below**, put it in its own folder (for example `Documents\Plunder`) and run it. Everything Plunder saves goes into a `Plunder Data` folder next to it. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click **More info → Run anyway**.

Plunder checks this page when it starts and can update itself (Settings → Updates).

### What's inside
- Java: Vanilla, Fabric, Quilt, Forge and NeoForge instances
- Mods and modpacks from Modrinth and CurseForge, with update checks and missing-mod warnings
- Bedrock: several versions side by side, separate worlds and add-ons per installation, add-ons from Planet Minecraft, ModBay and CurseForge
- Import from other launchers, share modpacks as .mrpack files
- Crash helper, automatic world backups, servers with live status, skins & capes, play-time stats
